title: Persist reviewer heartbeat checkpoints
description: Add durable reviewer checkpoint state so an agent can ask for closures since its last review pass without relying on volatile operation history.
acceptanceCriteria: Named checkpoints store the last reviewed closedAt/event watermark per reviewer and optional container scope.
CLI can create, show, and advance a heartbeat, and candidate queries can use --since-heartbeat without dropping items closed at equal timestamps.
Checkpoint state has schema validation, docs, and tests, and survives sync refresh.
Checkpoint outcome is recorded as a scoped commit or dirty-path reason code before closeout.
closedReason: reviewer heartbeat checkpoints implemented and verified
